title: Prompt injection (direct or indirect) changes system behaviour
source: CoSAI riskPromptInjection; OWASP LLM01; ATLAS AML.T0051
controls: Input filtering; Tool allow-list; Output checks

title: Rogue actions: agent takes unintended actions with real effect
source: CoSAI riskRogueActions; OWASP LLM06; OWASP ASI02
controls: Refund cap $100; Human approval above cap; Kill switch

title: Information security: model or integration widens attack surface
Data privacy: leakage or unauthorised use or disclosure of personal information
source: NIST AI 600-1 #4; CoSAI riskSensitiveDataDisclosure; OWASP LLM02; Privacy Act (AU-6)
controls: PII redaction in logs; No-training contract term

title: Personal information entered into public consumer AI tools (shadow AI)
Misleading statements or promises by a customer-facing AI
Permission leak: retrieval returns documents the user may not see
source: OWASP LLM08, LLM02; research B2 (permission-aware retrieval)

title: Agent goal hijack via retrieved or tool content
Confabulation: confidently stated but false output relied on
source: NIST AI 600-1 #2; CoSAI riskInsecureModelOutput; OWASP LLM09
controls: Grounding in policy docs; Answer citations

title: Insecure model output passed to downstream systems or users
Value chain: third-party model change, deprecation or opaque components
source: NIST AI 600-1 #12; APRA AI letter (AU-15) supplier risk

title: Excessive data handling during inference (retention, logging, vendor reuse)
Unbounded consumption or denial of wallet from public traffic
Supplier concentration with no tested exit or substitution plan
source: APRA AI letter (AU-15); CPS 230 (AU-13) where APRA-regulated

title: Retrieval or vector store poisoning
Identity and privilege abuse: over-scoped or shared agent credentials
controls: Scoped short-lived credentials; Separate service account

title: Tool source provenance: untrusted tool or MCP server
Human-AI configuration: automation bias or over-reliance by staff
Harmful, hateful or abusive content shown to the public
Runaway agent tool loops and cascading failures
Memory and context poisoning across sessions
